title: Patch: intent toward Collection, Decks and other catalog screens prefetches the engine and scene data

**Issue #4288 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4288: Patch: intent toward Collection, Decks and other catalog screens prefetches the engine and scene data
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When a player hovers their cursor over, touches, or tabs to the Collection button on the navigation bar, or clicks a link to the deck builder, card almanac, or statistics pages, the game currently prefetches only a lightweight placeholder script, leaving the heavier game engine and card graphics data to download only after the link is clicked. Consequently, navigating into the Collection or Decks screens displays a visible "Loading…" spinner panel while waiting for the engine to initialize. Once built, intent toward any screen that displays cards will prefetch the engine and card data in the background during the hover or touch gesture, allowing the Collection, Decks, Almanac, and Stats screens to appear immediately without a loading screen interruption.

## Why

- In PR #4180 (#4180, R711000) and PR #4241 (#4222), the web client dropped its bundled static copy of `catalog.json` and card scene recipes to shrink first page load by over 500 KB gzipped. Instead, screens displaying cards (`/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, `/patch-notes`) read `currentCatalog()` from the WebAssembly engine module and render behind `<EngineGate>` in `apps/web/src/main.tsx`.
- However, the route intent prefetching system in `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx` (introduced under R2116000, #2116) was never updated to reflect this shift. Its `ENGINE_CHUNKS` set only lists game board routes (`practice`, `play`, `match`, `series`, `duos`, `lobby`, `watch`, `dungeon`, `dungeonStats`, `daily`, `dailyGame`).
- When a user hovers over or touches "Collection" (`ShellLink` in `apps/web/src/shell/MenuShell.tsx`), `watchRouteIntent` triggers `prefetchRoute("/collection")`. Because `"collection"` is missing from `ENGINE_CHUNKS`, `prefetchRoute` loads only the route component chunk (`collection.tsx`) and skips `loadWasm()`, `loadSoundTables()`, and `loadSceneData()`.
- On click, `EngineGate` mounts, observes that WebAssembly and scene data are not ready, and renders the loading skeleton (`shellTestid.engineLoading`).
- Adding the remaining routes gated by `EngineGate` (`collection`, `decks`, `almanac`, `stats`, `patchNotes`, `together`, `leaderboard`) to `ENGINE_CHUNKS` closes this gap, restoring the instant navigation guarantee of R2116000 across all card screens.

## Proposal

- In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`:
  Expand `ENGINE_CHUNKS` to include `"collection"`, `"decks"`, `"almanac"`, `"stats"`, `"patchNotes"`, `"together"`, and `"leaderboard"` (matching the screens wrapped by `<EngineGate>` in `main.tsx`).
- In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx`:
  Add unit tests asserting that `pointerenter`, `focus`, and `touchstart` intent on links to `/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, and `/patch-notes` calls `loadWasm()` and `loadSceneData()`, while non-engine routes (`/privacy`, `/terms`, `/copyright`) continue to fetch only their screen chunk without initiating engine or scene loads.
- Update `spec/rulings/R2116000.md` to document that intent toward card catalog and deck workshop screens also starts the engine and scene data now that the catalog is served by the engine module.

## Where it lands

- [`apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/suggest/apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx#L96-L109): expand `ENGINE_CHUNKS`
- [`apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/suggest/apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx#L153-L170): unit tests for intent prefetching on card and deck routes
- [`spec/rulings/R2116000.md`](file:///home/agent-agy/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/suggest/spec/rulings/R2116000.md): update R2116000 note and citations

## Acceptance criteria

- Hovering (`pointerenter`), focusing, or touching (`touchstart`) links or buttons pointing to `/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, `/patch-notes`, `/together`, or `/leaderboard` triggers `loadWasm()` and `loadSceneData()` alongside the screen chunk import.
- Intent toward engine-free screens (`/privacy`, `/terms`, `/purchases`, `/accessibility`, `/copyright`) continues to prefetch only the screen component chunk without invoking `loadWasm()`, `loadSoundTables()`, or `loadSceneData()`.
- When Chromium Save-Data is enabled (`navigator.connection.saveData === true`), all prefetching remains disabled.
- Unit tests in `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/chunks.test.tsx` pass.
- `first-load.test.ts` passes with no increase to the entry bundle size (prefetching logic only runs on user interaction events).

## Size and risks

- Size: Small (`difficulty:medium`). Approximately 20–30 lines of code across `chunks.tsx`, `chunks.test.tsx`, and `R2116000.md`.
- Risks: Very low. Prefetching is opportunistic, guarded by Chromium Save-Data and a once-per-session prefetch cache, and all loaders (`loadWasm`, `loadSoundTables`, `loadSceneData`) are idempotent and cache their in-flight promises. Any network error during prefetch is silently caught, leaving standard error handling intact when navigating.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44673576338)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Intent toward any card screen (`/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, `/patch-notes`, plus `/together` and `/leaderboard`) prefetches the route chunk together with the engine and scene data, so those screens render with no `EngineGate` loading panel. Engine-free screens keep prefetching only their chunk, Save-Data still disables everything, and `R2116000.md` documents the widened scope.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx` | change | `ENGINE_CHUNKS` set (lines 96–109): add 7 chunk names with a `#4288` comment |
| `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx` | change | `vi.doMock` for the scene loader; 3 new `it("R2116000 …")` tests |
| `spec/rulings/R2116000.md` | change | Body text (engine-starter list) and `cards:` front matter |

Do not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold owns them); `spec/pending/` (no new ruling, so nothing to fold); `apps/web/src/main.tsx` (its `EngineGate` wrapping is already correct). Governing spec: `[[§10.10]]` (client behavior) via `[[R2116000]]`; presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7), pure crates untouched (rule 4), no new numbers (rule 9).

## Steps

1. In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`, add to `ENGINE_CHUNKS`, after `"lobby"` (order inside the set is irrelevant), exactly:
   `"collection"`, `"decks"`, `"almanac"`, `"stats"`, `"patchNotes"`, `"together"`, `"leaderboard"`.
   Above the added names put one comment: `// #4288: the catalog screens read the module's currentCatalog() behind EngineGate (#4180, #4222), so intent starts it too.` All seven keys already exist in `routeChunks`; `chunkAt` already maps `/patch-notes` to `"patchNotes"` and strips query strings, so no other function changes.
2. In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.test.tsx`, before the existing `await import("./chunks.tsx")`, add:
   `const loadSceneData = vi.fn((): Promise<void> => Promise.resolve());`
   `vi.doMock("../cards/art/sceneLoader.ts", () => ({ loadSceneData }));`
   Copy the existing `vi.doMock("../wasm/index.ts", …)` pattern at the top of the file. `chunks.tsx` imports `loadSceneData` as a direct named binding, so `vi.spyOn` cannot intercept it — the module mock is required. Keep the real `soundTablesLoader` unmocked so its internal `loadWasm()` call (soundTablesLoader.ts:42) keeps proving the engine prefetch through the existing `loadWasm` mock.
3. In the same file's `beforeEach`, add `loadSceneData.mockClear();` beside the existing `loadWasm.mockClear()`.
4. Add `it("R2116000 intent toward the catalog screens starts loadWasm() and loadSceneData()", …)`: render links to `/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, `/patch-notes`; spy each chunk's `load` with `mockResolvedValue(stubModule)` (copy the Practice test at line 153); fire `pointerEnter` on Collection, `focus` on Decks, `touchStart` on Almanac (covers all three `INTENT_EVENTS`), `pointerEnter` on the rest; expect each chunk `load` called once, `loadWasm` called 5 times, `loadSceneData` called 5 times.
5. Add `it("R2116000 intent toward Together and the leaderboard starts loadWasm() and loadSceneData()", …)`: links to `/together` (`pointerEnter`) and `/leaderboard` (`focus`); expect both chunk loads once, `loadWasm` twice, `loadSceneData` twice.
6. Add `it("R2116000 intent toward engine-free screens loads only their chunk", …)`: links to `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/purchases`, `/accessibility`, `/copyright` with mixed `pointerEnter`/`focus`/`touchStart`; expect each chunk `load` called once and `loadWasm` plus `loadSceneData` not called. Do not modify the existing tests.
7. In `spec/rulings/R2116000.md`, replace the second sentence (`Practice, Play, … also start the engine, which only matters if the boot download (#778) failed.`) with: `Screens behind EngineGate also start the engine and the scene data: the boards (Practice, Play, a match, a series, a Duos match, a watched game, the Dungeon run and its stats, the dailies, a lobby) and, now that the catalog is served by the engine module (issues #4180, #4222 and #4288), the Collection, the deck workshop, the Almanac, Statistics, the patch notes, Play together and the leaderboard.` Append `, issue #4288` to the `cards:` front-matter line. Leave `proven_in` unchanged.

## Tests

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/chunks.test.tsx` — the 3 new tests plus all existing `R2116000` tests pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/first-load.test.ts` — passes; the 7 added strings live in the already-entry-chunk `chunks.tsx`, far below the gzip-budget headroom.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check` — clean (edited note keeps its id, valid `[[§10.10]]` links, and its `proven_in` tests keep their `R2116000` names).

## Done when

- [ ] `pointerenter`/`focus`/`touchstart` on `/collection`, `/decks`, `/almanac`, `/stats`, `/patch-notes`, `/together`, `/leaderboard` triggers the chunk import plus `loadWasm()` (via `loadSoundTables`) and `loadSceneData()`.
- [ ] Intent on `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/purchases`, `/accessibility`, `/copyright` loads only the chunk — no `loadWasm()`, `loadSoundTables()`, or `loadSceneData()`.
- [ ] Save-Data (`navigator.connection.saveData === true`) still disables all prefetching (existing test).
- [ ] `chunks.test.tsx`, `first-load.test.ts`, typecheck, and `spec check` all pass; entry bundle not increased.
- [ ] No file outside the three listed above is modified.

## Risks

- Real `loadSoundTables()` runs in the new tests (it already does in the Practice/Dungeon tests): it imports `./soundTables.ts` dynamically after the mocked `loadWasm` resolves — same cost as existing engine-route tests, no flakiness added.
- `loadSceneData` is mocked for the whole file, so these tests no longer exercise the real scene import on engine intent — acceptable: real scene loading is covered by `engine-gate` tests; here only the call-on-intent wiring is under test.
- The folded `spec/11-rulings.md` paragraph for `R2116000` keeps its old narrower wording until the daily fold regenerates from the note; precedent (dungeon/daily joining the set under test `B13` with no note change at all).

## Open questions

None. Decisions made and rejected: no new ruling number (this applies `R2116000`'s existing decision to more engine-gated screens after #4180/#4222, not a new Hearthstone-semantics call — minting `R4288000` rejected); no `spec/pending/4288.md` (nothing new to fold); `account` correctly excluded (no chunk exists — statically in the entry chunk, so `chunkAt` returns null); `hotseat`/`duosDev` excluded (dev-only, production-null) and `fxGallery` excluded (never calls the engine per `R2784000`); `shop`/`replays` excluded (not `EngineGate`-wrapped).
```
